Operating Characteristics of Several Designs in One Table

Source: R/oc_results.R
oc_results.Rd

Collect the results of the simulation functions of different designs (and of oc_3p3) into one long data frame, so that the designs can be tabulated and drawn side by side. The result has print() and plot() methods; oc_compare judges the same results against the true doses.

Usage

oc_results(...)

Arguments

...

Design results, named by the design, for example oc_results(BOIN12 = res_a, "BOIN-ET" = res_b). Each is the result of a simulation function for one scenario (such as sim_boin() or sim_boin12()), of its _multi version, of oc_3p3, or a list of such single-scenario results named by the scenarios (the way to give oc_3p3() several scenarios). Unnamed results are named after their design. All results must be for a single agent or all for a drug combination, with the same number of doses.

Value

A data frame of class c("oc_results", "data.frame") with the columns

design

Factor of the design names, in the order given.

target_type

"MTD" or "OBD", what the design selects.

scenario

Factor of the scenario names. A single-scenario result is named "Scenario 1".

dose

Dose level, or dose_a and dose_b for a combination; NA for the quantities of the whole trial.

metric

Factor: per dose, "sel_percent" (percentage of trials selecting the dose), "n_pts", "n_tox" and "n_resp" (average numbers of patients, DLTs and responses); per trial, "percent_no_selection" (percentage of trials selecting no dose), "total_n_pts", "total_n_tox", "total_n_resp" and "duration" (average trial duration, for the designs with time). Quantities a design does not record are left out.

value

The value.

with the attributes type ("single" or "combination") and dims.

Details

The values are those of the components sel_percent, n_pts_dose, n_tox_dose, n_resp_dose, percent_no_mtd or percent_no_obd, total_n_pts, total_n_tox, total_n_resp and duration_mean or duration of the results; nothing is simulated again.

See also

oc_scenarios, oc_compare, print.oc_results, plot.oc_results

Examples

scen <- list(
  "Scenario 1" = list(p_true = c(0.05, 0.12, 0.27, 0.35, 0.50),
                      p_resp = c(0.20, 0.35, 0.36, 0.37, 0.38))
)
boin12 <- sim_boin12_multi(target = 0.35, target_resp = 0.25,
                           scenarios = scen, n_cohort = 12,
                           cohort_size = 3, n_trials = 200, seed = 1)
boin <- sim_boin_multi(target = 0.35, scenarios = scen, n_cohort = 12,
                       cohort_size = 3, n_trials = 200, seed = 1)
res <- oc_results(BOIN12 = boin12, BOIN = boin)
head(res)
#> Operating characteristics of 1 design(s) in 1 scenario(s)
#> 
#> Scenario 1
#> Selection (%) by dose
#>           1    2    3    4   5
#> BOIN12 16.5 49.5 22.5 10.5 1.0
#> Patients by dose
#>          1
#> BOIN12 6.8
res
#> Operating characteristics of 2 design(s) in 1 scenario(s)
#> 
#> Scenario 1
#> Selection (%) by dose
#>           1    2    3    4    5
#> BOIN12 16.5 49.5 22.5 10.5  1.0
#> BOIN    0.0  9.0 38.5 39.0 13.5
#> Patients by dose
#>          1    2    3   4   5
#> BOIN12 6.8 12.6  8.7 5.7 2.1
#> BOIN   4.0  7.1 10.7 8.5 3.3
#> Per trial (averages)
#>        No selection (%) Patients DLTs Responses
#> BOIN12              0.0     36.0  7.5      11.8
#> BOIN                0.0     33.6  8.7         -
